authentication: Real verified owner bearer; deviceId selects a currently paired Pin, never authenticates a request

GET /.semantics: All active owner approvals remain discoverable and revocable. Pairing is rechecked; unavailable lookup gives currentPaired:null, never admission authority. Not online or admission proof.

request.deviceId: nonempty hex, at most 128 characters, canonicalized lowercase

POST /.semantics: Explicit approval after current pairing lookup. Same account/device retains surfaceId; reapproval advances revision. Atomic registry and ledger commit.

DELETE /:surfaceId.semantics: Idempotent owner revocation, same registry and ledger. Does not unpair or revoke PKI credentials.

PinSurface.currentPaired: true on POST; boolean or null on GET/DELETE (null means pairing lookup unavailable; owner inventory and revocation remain available). Not online or admission proof
PinSurface.deviceId: canonical lowercase hex; owner management only, never model context
PinSurface.name: Ai Pin
PinSurface.audience: handheld; not a manifest field. A worn device declares one output channel and the runtime routes it as speech reaching the person wearing it. A Pin reports no foreground, so it is never penalised for attention and is never refused speech for lack of one.

limitations: Approval is neither physical privacy nor actor authentication
Stock boot epoch/sequence, rendering and playback remain unverified
Pin approvals accept no browser connection token/state
Current pairing and active runtime binding are rechecked before each stock assistant admission
This admission increment does not replace all legacy orchestration or memory authority
